Use case: ui-mockup. Create a NEW high-fidelity Korean web-interface approval comp, using the supplied image only as the approved VISUAL STYLE reference. The requested page is a real existing screen in "천하제일 단타대회". Preserve the B "대회 기록실" identity: white reading surface, expressive Korean Myeongjo ExtraBold headings, clear Korean sans-serif data, crisp thin ledger rules with restrained red section separators, colored printed rank numerals (1 ochre gold, 2 vermilion, 3 deep blue, remaining ink), pale gold selected rows, flat golden index-style buttons. The full header wordmark is "천하제일" red, a small original yellow circle/red-star emblem, "단타대회" gold. Follow the approved lettering and mature record-book personality, not a generic finance admin UI. Never turn the page into A's big yellow arena masthead. Body copy and data must be dark and legible.
Default composition: one clean LANDSCAPE approval board about 2400x1800, with a LARGE desktop full-page web design on the LEFT and a separately composed tall MOBILE full-page web design on the RIGHT. Desktop should have realistic broad content columns and a small right context rail; mobile should have clear stacked reading order and useful touch targets, not a shrunken desktop. Both depict the SAME requested page, same values and functionality. For long pages show the meaningful lower sections in the image as readable page continuations; small contextual explanations can be compact, section headings and actions must be readable. No photographed devices, perspective, gratuitous mockup shadows, giant outer slogans, fingers or cursors. Board outer text ONLY the requested board title, plus "데스크톱" and "모바일" labels.
Shared chrome: desktop wordmark, "메인", "랭킹", search field "기업·종목 검색", "최근 본", theme icon. Mobile wordmark, compact recent/theme actions, search entry as appropriate, bottom links "메인 / 랭킹 / 검색". Where a right context rail is useful, show a concise "최근 본" list, "조회 기준" and page contents; do not repeat the main current figure in another giant panel. Show only real current capabilities or plainly proposed arrangements of them.
Every screen has small but readable "예시 데이터 · 2026.10.08 기준". All numbers are synthetic review examples, not live market data. Shared stock examples: Samsung common "삼성전자 · 보통주 · 005930" marketcap495조, price74,000원 +0.80%; Samsung preferred "삼성전자우 · 우선주 · 005935" marketcap54조, price54,000원; company Samsung aggregate549조 (=495+54), common90.2%, preferred9.8%. Rank arrows ↑1/↓1 always neutral INK, separate from Korean-market price-change red(up)/blue(down). Never imply higher rank is a better investment.
Do not invent slogans, "좋은 종목", "기회", "유망", recommendation copy, trading, account signup, favorites, real-time ticks, news, prizes, tournament participation, notifications or predictive claims. No medals/crowns, promotional illustrations, all-card dashboard grids, glowing gradients, beige grunge, literal anime characters or scenes. Use precisely the supplied page content; do not copy the three-phone journey storyboard as the new layout. Exact Korean labels and numbers should be legible and preserved.
